    AI Overview
    As of April 2026, John Ternus is the incoming CEO of Apple, taking over from Tim Cook, who is moving to executive chairman. A long-time Apple insider, Ternus has been the Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering since 2021, leading development on iPhone, Mac, iPad, and AirPods, and was instrumental in the Mac's transition to Apple silicon. 
    Key Facts About John Ternus: 
    • Career at Apple: Joined the Product Design team in 2001 and was promoted to Vice President of Hardware Engineering in 2013.
    • Key Accomplishments: Oversees hardware engineering for major product lines (iPad, AirPods, iPhone, Mac). He played a key role in the success of the Mac's transition to in-house silicon.
    • Previous Role: As Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering, he joined Apple's executive team in 2021.
    • Background: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Pennsylvania.
    • Key Traits: Described as having a "careful, low-profile style," while being a key technical leader at the company. 
    Ternus is often seen as a key figure in Apple's product keynotes and is considered a veteran leader within the company's executive team.
